targets.title: The Dead Hand of the Past? Toward an Understanding of ‘Constitutional Veneration'.
targets.evidence_quote: To do this, we refine and build on Zink and Dawes’s study by attempting to replicate their results on a representative sample of US adults through the 2016 Cooperative Congressional Election Study (CCES).
targets.outcome_quote: Our findings bolster Zink and Dawes’s conclusion that a specific bias in favor of the Constitution can act as an obstacle to constitutional amendment and demonstrate that their findings generalize to a representative sample.

reasoning: Two new survey experiments retest the constitutional status quo bias of the named original; both support it. Brown and Pope supply a measure rather than a target finding.
